about_the_game:
Since Season 6: HECU, Cross Product Multiplayer has enjoyed its fair share of musical scores. In your hands, you possess those scores in full quality, including additional sub-mixes, unused cues, and more, in blissful uncompressed quality.

This record contains all of the scores & cures recorded and produced for Cross Product Multiplayer, from Season 5, up to Season 9: White Sands. That's versions 2.5, 2.6, 2.7, 2.8, and 2.9.
